text: あいてに　なりきって　じぶんも　あいてと　おなじ　とくせいに　へんかする。

structure.jp: あいてに　なりきって
あいてと　おなじ　とくせいに　へんかする。
structure.en: changes to the same Ability as the opponent.

patterns.name: 〜きる
patterns.explanation: きる added to a verb says the thing is done all the way, with nothing left over. あいてに　なりきって = 'becoming the opponent completely'.

patterns.name: 〜とおなじ
patterns.span: あいてと　おなじ　とくせい
patterns.explanation: と before おなじ tells you what something is the same as. あいてと　おなじ　とくせい = 'the same Ability as the opponent'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one, like 'and'. あいてに　なりきって　…　へんかする = 'becomes the opponent completely and changes'.
